title: Discovery of a Potent and Orally Bioavailable Hypoxia-Inducible Factor 2alpha (HIF-2alpha) Agonist and Its Synergistic Therapy with Prolyl Hydroxylase Inhibitors for the Treatment of Renal Anemia.
authors: Yu, Yancheng; Yang, Fulai; Yu, Quanwei; Liu, Simeng; Wu, Chenyang; Su, Kaijun; Yang, Le; Bao, Xiaoqian; Li, Zhihong; Li, Xiang; Zhang, Xiaojin
one_liner_zh: 该文发现HIF-2α小分子激动剂并用MD模拟其变构增强HIF-2二聚化，但核心是药物化学与贫血治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅MD模拟为边缘方法关联。
abstract: Activation of hypoxia-inducible factor 2 (HIF-2) has emerged as a potent renal anemia treatment strategy. Here, the benzisothiazole derivative 26 was discovered as a novel HIF-2alpha agonist, which first demonstrated nanomolar activity (EC(50) = 490 nM, E(max) = 349.2%) in the luciferase reporter gene assay. Molecular dynamics simulations indicated that 26 could allosterically enhance HIF-2 dimerization. Furthermore, compound 26 had a good pharmacokinetic profile (the oral bioavailability in rats was 41.38%) and an in vivo safety profile (the LD(50) in mice was greater than 708 mg.kg(-1)). In the in vivo efficacy assays, the combination of 26 and the prolyl hydroxylase inhibitor, AKB-6548, was confirmed for the first time to synergistically increase the plasma erythropoietin level in mice (from 260 to 2296 pg.mL(-1)) and alleviate zebrafish anemia induced by doxorubicin. These results provide new insights for HIF-2alpha agonists and the treatment of renal anemia.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子2（HIF-2）的激活已成为一种有效的肾性贫血治疗策略。在此，苯并异噻唑衍生物26被发现为一种新型HIF-2α激动剂，其在荧光素酶报告基因检测中首次展现出纳摩尔级活性（EC(50) = 490 nM，E(max) = 349.2%）。分子动力学模拟表明，26能够变构增强HIF-2二聚化。此外，化合物26具有良好的药代动力学特性（大鼠口服生物利用度为41.38%）和体内安全性（小鼠LD(50)大于708 mg.kg(-1)）。在体内药效实验中，首次证实26与脯氨酰羟化酶抑制剂AKB-6548联合使用可协同提高小鼠血浆促红细胞生成素水平（从260升至2296 pg.mL(-1)），并缓解多柔比星诱导的斑马鱼贫血。这些结果为HIF-2α激动剂及肾性贫血治疗提供了新见解。
